title: Woman Goes Absolutely Ballistic At The Airport
description:
On March 9th, 2023, an officer on patrol at an airport was approached by a woman inquiring about programs for discounted or free flights. The officer advised her to speak directly with the airlines. When she couldn’t find any such programs, she became agitated and left. She then began asking random passengers for help. Suspecting that she was harassing others, the officer approached her again, but she verbally abused him. The officer repeatedly requested her to get off the road and walk on the sidewalk, but she ignored his commands. With no other choice, he took strict measures, which triggered her even more. Seeing the officer struggle while arresting the woman, airport security personnel latched onto her to help contain her, but she bit him as well. It seemed the woman was in no mood to cooperate with the officers, as she actively tried to bite and kick them. The woman bit the officer severely, breaking his skin and causing the wound to swell. He was later sent to a hospital for treatment. She was soon examined by medical professionals. She was charged with resisting arrest with and without violence, as well as battery on a peace officer.

The featured content is NOT intended to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved or to glorify violence in any way.
